fields.label: Port
fields.help: The TCP port devices connect to. 1883 is MQTT's own; change it only when something else holds it.

fields.label: Let clients connect without a password
fields.help: Anyone on the network could then read and write every topic. Off unless a device cannot be given a username.

fields.label: Home Assistant discovery
fields.help: Devices that announce themselves the way Home Assistant reads - Tasmota, ESPHome, Shelly, OpenMQTTGateway - become devices of the house.

fields.label: Discovery prefix
fields.help: The topic the announcements are under.
fields.patternMessage: Topic levels of letters, digits, dashes and underscores
